name: The Metro Faction
description: Someone in the Moscow Metro tunnels has been accessing the Archivist's restricted archive sections and copying sensitive pre-war Russian government documents. She needs to know who, and why, before what they've found reaches the wrong hands.

stages.name: Enter the Moscow Metro
stages.description: Descend into the Moscow Metro system and find your way to the Archivist's section. The tunnels are inhabited and factionalized — move carefully.

stages.name: Identify the Faction
stages.description: Follow the evidence trail left by whoever has been accessing the restricted sections. The Archivist has found partial handprints on three archive containers — trace their movement through the tunnels.

stages.name: Stop the Data Leak
stages.description: Confront the faction before their copied documents leave the Metro. The Archivist wants the copies recovered — what happens to the faction is the player's decision.
